'''September 2000 Las Vegas tournament (16 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas, NV on 16 September 2000. [[Matt Berta]] won it. It is known from Matt Berta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1254">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-20-las-vegas-nv-9-16-00d1254/ las-vegas-nv-9-16-00], DeckTech (Matt "Phobos" Berta, 20 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-20-las-vegas-nv-9-16-00d1254/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, NV
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Berta]]
